How does hydrogen bond affect the physical properties of compound?
Affect of Hydrogen Bond on Physical properties:

Melting point and boiling point: Stronger the hydrogen bond, greater the intermolecular attraction and larger heat energy is required to separate the molecule before they melt or boil• So the compound having hydrogen bond possess high melting or boiling point. Example: alcohols have high boiling than ether.

Density, surface tension, viscosity: Strength of hydrogen bond measures the strength Of b. density, surface tension and viscosity of compound. Example: glycerol is more viscous liquid due to larger number of H-bond.
Physical state: Water exists in liquid state and hydrogen sulphide exist in gaseous state.
Solubility: Hydrogen bonding affects the solubility of one substance in another. Example: alcohol and carboxylic acid dissolve in water.
